title: No size/validity bounds on keyword and header-name fields
description: EmailFilterCondition string fields (hasKeyword, allInThreadHaveKeyword, someInThreadHaveKeyword, noneInThreadHaveKeyword, notKeyword) accept arbitrary-length strings. RFC 8621 §4.1.1 specifies keywords are 1-255 chars, ASCII %x21-%x7e, excluding specific chars. The header deserializer validates element count (1-2) but not header-name validity or element string length. A malicious server could send oversized values. Type crates are not required to validate, but this gap should be documented, and a validate() fn or note in the doc comment would be appropriate.
